why: CAPTURED and SYNTHETIC are different claims and must never be told apart by guessing at a filename. A captured fixture is what a host actually said and can be cited as evidence; a synthetic one is what this adapter believes a host would say, and can only prove that the READER is correct if it does. This manifest states which is which, where each came from, and the digest of the bytes as recorded — so a synthetic fixture cannot be quietly promoted, and a captured one cannot be quietly edited into agreement with the code that reads it.
